column1: # Roots and barriers of the shared-state audit (audit_shared_state.py).
# consumer<TAB>regex: a function the second-core worker runs while it draws a queued shape
#   (the adapter, and the callbacks the draw code reaches through pointers).
# game<TAB>regex: a platform function the game thread reaches through a pointer.
# barrier<TAB>regex<TAB>why: a function that draws what is queued before anything else;
#   what it reaches is not followed on the game side.
# Regexes are matched against demangled names.
